answer: In this PoA design, bonded collateral is escrowed per identity, but equivocation evidence is grouped by correlated signing behavior: when k identities coordinate, the assessed penalty scales as O(k²), not as k independent fixed fines. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, so splitting control across a sybil swarm increases exposure rather than diluting it. Names such as ferrous, lotus, or harbor do not alter this rule; only verifiable evidence and protocol-defined attribution determine slashing.
